description: Shared Renovate rules for satoukouga's repositories: one pull request per update, each with a review request; nothing merges automatically.
Repositories add their base branch (baseBranchPatterns) and their own managers and package rules on top.

customManagers.description: Versions annotated in a workflow or action: `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` (optionally `versioning=` and `extractVersion=`) on the line above a `key: <version>` entry. An image reference is read as its tag.

packageRules.description: pnpm pinned twice, in package.json's packageManager and in mise.toml, moves as one update.

Images and OCI artifacts from registries other than Docker Hub (ghcr.io, mcr.microsoft.com, quay.io, ...) give Renovate no release time, so minimumReleaseAge would hold their updates forever; they get no minimum age.
